sources.citation: Garcia, Bermolen, Jonckheere and Shneer, Efficiency of parallel and restart exploration strategies in model-free stochastic simulations, Stochastic Systems 16(3), 264-288 (2026)
sources.conjecture: paragraph after Corollary 3.15 (arXiv v3); restart theorem Theorem 3.14 (journal Theorem 4); restart law Lemma 6.2 (journal Lemma 5); faulty step Proof 6.4

boundary: 'proof' means a complete written proof in the manuscript, not formal verification; 'certified' means exact rational or outward-rounded interval arithmetic for the stated constants of one model; 'numerical' is deterministic high-precision computation, not an enclosure; 'exploratory' is a conjecture supported by computation. Internal AI-assisted review is not peer review or independent reproduction.

claims.statement: For every b>0, L^2 A_L(-b) -> K_ell(b) and L^2 e^{-bL} A_L(b) -> K_r(b), where A_L is the Laplace transform of the Esscher-centred QSD on (0,L), K_ell(b)=pi^2 m_+/(2 b phi_+(b)), K_r(b)=pi^2 m_-/(2 b phi_-(b)).

M_L(theta) -> K_ell(eta-theta)/K_ell(eta) (theta<eta); M_L(eta)/L^2 -> 1/K_ell(eta); e^{-(theta-eta)L} M_L(theta) -> K_r(theta-eta)/K_ell(eta) (theta>eta). Hence M_L(lambda*) ~ C* e^{(lambda*-eta)L}, C* = G_+(lambda*-eta)/G_-(eta).
C*=1 for Brownian motion with drift; C* = eta^2 v/(2 kappa_inf) < 1 for spectrally negative X with jumps; C* > 1 for spectrally positive X with jumps.

Idealised QSD restart: p_L(B) = 1 - exp(-r_L B) (source Lemma 6.2), r_L ~ R* e^{-eta L}, R* = (m_-/m_+) phi_+(eta)^2; sup_{B>0} |p_L(B)/(1-exp(-R* B e^{-eta L})) - 1| <= |a_L - 1| -> 0; the failure probability is not uniformly approximated in relative terms.

The two-sided bound (17) of the source's Theorem 3.14 holds along B_L (with liminf psi'(lambda*) B_L / L > 1) iff B_L = O(e^{eta L}); its ratio tends to 0 if B_L e^{-eta L} -> infinity. An exact Brownian example inside the source's Corollary 3.15 refutes the stated range B = o(e^{lambda* L}).

Spectrally negative X with sigma >= 0 satisfying the cumulant conditions and scale-function positivity (Q): all moment and restart conclusions hold with C* = eta^2 psi''(eta)/(2 kappa_inf) <= 1 and R* = eta^2 psi''(eta)/2. (Q) holds when the laws of X_t are absolutely continuous; for compound-Poisson-plus-drift models it is checked numerically.

claims.status: proof given QSD-density regularity (F1); second-order constants numerical
claims.statement: Source model: L^2 alpha_L = (pi^2 v/2)(L/(L+delta))^2 + O(L^-2), delta = delta_+ + delta_- = 0.302842199807; C_L/C*, R_L/R* = 1 + g/L + O(L^-2), g = (pi^2/2)(delta_- - delta_+) = 0.497397109519.
The same first-order formulas hold for the whole class.

exclusions: No claim for two-sided pure-jump processes or random walks.
No claim about Fleming-Viot or other approximate QSD sampling, restart overhead, or discrete monitoring (heuristic remarks only).
